title: Exact pullback shift from tensor with the translated unit
statement: Let f: Z -> Y be proper between Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in one localization universe, the recorded tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] and derived pullback F [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Supply any strong monoidal structure on F, with inverse tensorator delta. Write c_X(K) for the explicit translated-unit isomorphism [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. There exist a coherent integer-shift structure s on F and an isomorphism e: F(O_Y[1]) -> O_Z[1] such that F with s is triangulated and, for every K in D(O_Y), s(1)_K is F(c_Y(K)^-1); delta_(O_Y[1],K); (e tensor id_(F K)); c_Z(F K). No tensorator-shift square is asserted.

source.place: Exact K-flat derived pullback; translated-unit construction of the parent plan (08EU)

proof.text: Obtain the translated-unit isomorphism e and preservation of localized distinguished homotopy triangles from lem-sc-derived-pullback-translated-unit-triangles.

Prove naturality of c_X from the recorded two-variable Koszul shift and left-unitor naturality. Obtain inverse naturality by cancellation. Expand the explicit translated-unit pullback composite; use inverse-tensorator naturality and whisker exchange. NatIso.ofComponents packages the formula into a natural degree-one isomorphism.
Extend that natural degree-one comparison to CommShift ℤ with its degree-one equation using lem-sc-integer-shift-from-one. This step is fully proved in Lean.

Use Mathlib Functor.distTriang_iff for the canonical Qh to represent any distinguished derived triangle as isomorphic to a localized distinguished homotopy triangle. Apply the localized-triangle lemma. Rewrite only the outer pullback shift comparison by the degree-one equation, and transport distinguishedness through pullback.mapTriangle.mapIso of the representing triangle isomorphism. Package this as IsTriangulated. The component formula follows by rewriting the same degree-one equation and reflexivity.

proof_origin.place: J3: proved naturality, integer extension and homotopy-localization descent; remaining cone normalization is lem-sc-derived-pullback-translated-unit-triangles
